sources.name: GBIF
sources.value: Taxon identity, occurrence records, density and map context
sources.limitations: Occurrence records are not range, abundance, population or live position. Search pages are capped and require pagination; large extraction should use the download service.

sources.name: OBIS
sources.value: Marine occurrence records and tile/grid access
sources.limitations: Occurrence records are not migration routes, live locations or population estimates.

sources.name: NASA GIBS
sources.value: Global scientific imagery including true colour, SST, NDVI, sea ice, aerosol, precipitation and thermal anomaly products
sources.limitations: Product cadence and time semantics differ by layer; imagery is not automatically an interpreted ecological signal.

sources.name: NASA EONET v3
sources.authority: NASA Earth Observatory Natural Event Tracker
sources.value: Provider-reported natural event records and geometry history
sources.limitations: Open status is provider/editorial state, not proof of local urgency or ecological consequence.

sources.name: USGS Earthquake Hazards
sources.value: Recent global earthquake records
sources.limitations: A seismic event is a geophysical record, not automatically an ecological impact.

sources.name: NOAA Coral Reef Watch
sources.value: Coral heat-stress products including Degree Heating Weeks
sources.limitations: Heat stress is not observed bleaching; product date and resolution must remain visible.

sources.name: Global Forest Watch
sources.authority: World Resources Institute and source partners
sources.value: Global tree-cover loss and forest-change context
sources.limitations: Tree-cover loss is not equivalent to deforestation or a single causal driver; current dataset version and tile terms must be verified.

sources.name: iNaturalist Observations
sources.value: Community observation records with photos where individual media licences permit use
sources.limitations: Observation licence and photo licence can differ; geoprivacy and obscured/private coordinates must be respected.

sources.name: WoRMS
sources.value: Marine taxonomy and names
sources.limitations: Taxonomy only; taxon identifiers must never be substituted for occurrence-record identity.

sources.name: Climate TRACE
sources.value: Emissions assets, facilities, sectors and reported/estimated emissions
sources.limitations: Reporting period, methodology and estimated-vs-measured semantics must remain explicit. Emissions records do not establish legal liability or wrongdoing.

sources.name: EMODnet Bathymetry
sources.authority: European Marine Observation and Data Network
sources.value: Pan-European bathymetry and marine terrain context
sources.limitations: Use product/version metadata and legend from capabilities; prefer WMTS for interactive performance where suitable.

sources.name: EMODnet Seabed Habitats
sources.authority: European Marine Observation and Data Network
sources.value: European seabed-habitat products and map layers
sources.limitations: Habitat map/model products differ in source, scale, date and confidence; do not flatten them into one universal habitat truth.

sources.name: EMODnet Human Activities
sources.authority: European Marine Observation and Data Network
sources.value: Marine human-activity infrastructure and activity layers
sources.limitations: Layer-specific semantics and dates must be preserved; presence of an asset/activity is not a pressure or impact claim by itself.

sources.name: EMODnet Chemistry / Eutrophication
sources.authority: European Marine Observation and Data Network
sources.value: European marine chemistry and eutrophication context
sources.limitations: Dataset, parameter, period, interpolation and spatial coverage must be exposed; chemistry values require unit-safe rendering.

sources.name: Kartverket Stedsnavn
sources.value: Authoritative Norwegian place-name identity and search
sources.limitations: Place-name identity is not an administrative, hydrological or ecological boundary.

sources.name: Artsdatabanken / Artskart
sources.value: Norwegian taxon names and observation records, especially Oslofjord/local species
sources.limitations: Sensitive-species rules, source institution/dataset identity, duplicate handling against GBIF and image rights require explicit implementation.

sources.name: Vann-Nett / Norwegian water bodies
sources.value: Official Norwegian water-body geometry and source-reported assessment fields
sources.limitations: A selected 4PLANET Oslofjord collection must not be described as the official complete Oslofjord boundary or whole-fjord status.

sources.name: ICES Public Web Services
sources.authority: International Council for the Exploration of the Sea
sources.value: Selected public oceanographic, survey and fisheries datasets for the North Atlantic and adjacent seas
sources.limitations: Integrate only exact public services. VMS and restricted biodiversity/fisheries data must not be presented as public merely because ICES hosts related services.

sources.name: ICES DATRAS
sources.authority: International Council for the Exploration of the Sea
sources.value: Research-trawl survey haul and species data
sources.limitations: Survey catches are sampling records with survey-design context, not direct population or local-abundance truth.

sources.name: NASA FIRMS
sources.value: Record-level VIIRS/MODIS thermal anomaly detections with acquisition time, instrument, confidence and FRP fields
sources.limitations: Thermal anomaly is not automatically confirmed wildfire. Global daily queries can return tens of thousands of records; use bounded viewports, short date windows, cache and clustering.

sources.name: OpenAQ v3
sources.value: Ground-level air-quality monitoring stations and measurements
sources.limitations: Coverage varies by provider and place. Do not convert measurements into a generic AQI or health diagnosis without an explicit methodology.

sources.name: Global Fishing Watch
sources.value: AIS apparent fishing effort, vessel identity, fishing/encounter/port events and other maritime activity products
sources.limitations: AIS-derived apparent fishing effort does not prove illegal activity. Dataset caveats, delay, coverage and attribution must be shown.

sources.name: Protected Planet API v4
sources.value: Protected areas and OECMs
sources.limitations: Provider states that the public API is not available for commercial use. Do not activate publicly until intended use and licence route are confirmed.

sources.name: Copernicus Marine
sources.value: Ocean temperature, currents, chlorophyll, oxygen and other gridded/in-situ variables
sources.limitations: Select exact datasets and preprocess/cache bounded outputs. Do not build a generic browser connector or expose credentials client-side.

sources.name: OSPAR / ODIMS
sources.value: North-East Atlantic environmental, eutrophication, contaminants, litter, pressure and protection context
sources.limitations: Only exact usable services/layers count as integrated; layer-specific rights and dates must be recorded.

sources.name: EMODnet Physics
sources.authority: European Marine Observation and Data Network
sources.value: European marine physical observations and gridded products
sources.limitations: Choose bounded variables/products and preserve station/model/product semantics rather than treating all physics layers as equivalent.
